steps.message: What is my first event after 18:05 the Monday after next in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date '+NOW=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z (%u)'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simplemobiletools|simple.calendar|calendar.pro|fossify'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+NOW=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z (%u)'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simplemobiletools|simple.calendar|calendar.pro|fossify'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "T=$(date -u -d '2023-10-23 18:05:00' +%s 2>/dev/null || date -u -D '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' -d '2023-10-23 18:05:00' +%s); echo THRESHOLD_MS=$((T*1000)); content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName:name 2>/dev/null; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/instances/when/$((T*1000))/$(((T+1209600)*1000)) --projection begin:end:title:event_id --sort 'begin ASC' 2>/dev/null | head -n 20"
